proposals.lexicon_quote: USNS COMFORT (USFFC)	8109	333	Medical Support Equipment
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design under section 3: the matched index name is a ship - the platform the contract services - not the program the line funds. The award is a 120-day shipyard availability (drydock/repair) financed with 'Fiscal 2023 working capital funds (Navy)', while 8109 is an OPN 'Medical Support Equipment' line that buys medical equipment, not ship overhauls. Matching a hull name into an equipment line is exactly the platform trap, so no refute pass is spent on it.

proposals.announcement_evidence: in support of the DDG-51-class destroyer ship repair program
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design under section 3: 'DDG-51' here is a ship class - the platform being repaired - and the award is a selected restricted availability for USS Kidd, i.e. fleet maintenance, not construction of a DDG-51. The funding confirms the mismatch: 'Fiscal 2018 operations and maintenance (Navy); and fiscal 2018 working capital (Department of Defense) funds', against 2122 which is the SCN shipbuilding line (doc 341). The other near-match, 0900 'DDG Modernization (DDG MOD) Program', is not named in the announcement at all.

proposals.announcement_evidence: process potentially radiologically contaminated LM2500 Single Shank Turbine Gas Generator Assemblies
proposals.lexicon_quote: LM2500 DIGITAL FUEL CONTROL (DFC)	0131	333	Surface Power Equipment
proposals.rationale: Rejected by design under section 3: the award is generic depot sustainment services - 'specialized depot overhaul induction procedures' under an IDIQ - financed with 'Fiscal 2024 operation and maintenance (Navy) funding', hung on 0131 'Surface Power Equipment', an OPN procurement line (doc 333). The only thing shared with the index row is the engine designator LM2500; the row's actual item, the digital fuel control, is never mentioned, so the match is a substring of a component name and not the program the contract funds.
